# The NCA Hub — llms.txt
# https://www.thencahub.com

## What This Site Is
The NCA Hub is an NCA exam preparation platform for internationally trained
lawyers seeking Canadian law qualification through the National Committee on
Accreditation (NCA).

## Key Facts (2026) — quick answers
- Exam format: each NCA challenge exam is a 3-hour, open-book, online-proctored (MonitorEDU) written exam. Answers are typed. Hard-copy notes only; no electronic materials are allowed during the exam.
- Pass mark: 50%. Results are released approximately 10 to 12 weeks after the last exam in a session.
- Attempts: a maximum of 3 attempts per subject (one attempt plus two rewrites). A discretionary 4th attempt requires an approved remedial plan; there are no 5th attempts.
- Fees: CAD $500 per exam per subject per attempt (as of the February 2025 fee change); one-time NCA assessment fee CAD $400. Both plus applicable taxes.
- 2026 exam schedule: the NCA holds exam sittings in most months of the year (January through November). Each subject is offered on set dates several times a year, not in a single annual session. Full schedule by subject: https://www.thencahub.com/nca-exam-dates-2026/
- Mandatory subjects (same for every internationally trained lawyer): Administrative Law, Constitutional Law, Criminal Law, Professional Responsibility, Foundations of Canadian Law.
- Additional subjects (Contracts, Torts, Property Law, Civil Procedure, Family Law, Evidence, Business Organizations, etc.) are assigned by individual degree assessment, not by nationality.
- Since 1 March 2026: an Indigenous Law and Peoples competency is mandatory before the Certificate of Qualification is issued (completed via a CPLED online module or an approved course); and a language-competency screening precedes assessment for candidates whose legal education was not primarily in English or French.
- From 1 January 2029: under the amended 2024 National Requirement, two of the three years of an applicant's qualifying law degree must be completed through in-person instruction. This is a rule about the law degree, not the exams — the challenge exams remain online and remotely proctored.
- The NCA Hub notes: under 80 pages per subject, CAD $100 each (flat founding price), including answer templates and practice questions.

## Who It Is For
- Lawyers trained in India (Indian LLB graduates) — the largest audience segment
- Lawyers trained in the UK (LLB, LLM, GDL, SQE)
- Lawyers trained in Nigeria, Jamaica, the Philippines, Pakistan, and other common law jurisdictions
- Any foreign-qualified lawyer who needs to pass NCA challenge exams to practise law in Canada

## Important: NCA Subject Assignment
- The NCA assigns the SAME 5 mandatory subjects to ALL internationally trained lawyers:
  Administrative Law, Constitutional Law, Criminal Law, Professional Responsibility, Foundations of Canadian Law
- Additional elective subjects (Contracts, Torts, Property Law, etc.) are assigned based on each
  candidate's INDIVIDUAL degree assessment — not by nationality
- Elective assignments vary by person, not by country of qualification

## What It Offers
- Concise study notes: under 80 pages per NCA exam subject,
  tabbed and built to be usable inside a 3-hour open-book exam
- Answer templates for exam structure
- Free NCA Readiness Score — a 5-question subject-specific quiz
- Free sample chapter downloads by subject
- Guidance on the CPLED Legal Research and Writing (LRW) course
- Free elective exam guides (Contracts, Torts, Property Law, Business Organisations, Civil Procedure)
- Province-specific qualification guides (Ontario, British Columbia, Alberta)
- 35+ free blog articles covering NCA process, strategy, and subject-specific guidance
- Buyer's guide: are NCA notes worth it, how much to pay, how to choose — at /nca-notes-guide/

## Subjects Covered
Mandatory (same for all candidates):
- Administrative Law (NCA challenge exam) — notes available
- Constitutional Law (NCA challenge exam) — notes available
- Criminal Law (NCA challenge exam) — notes available
- Foundations of Canadian Law (NCA challenge exam) — notes available
- Professional Responsibility (NCA challenge exam) — notes available

Electives (assigned per individual degree assessment):
- Contract Law (NCA challenge exam) — notes available; free exam guide at /blog/nca-contracts-exam-guide/
- Family Law (NCA challenge exam) — notes available
- Evidence Law (NCA challenge exam) — notes available
- Property Law (NCA challenge exam) — notes available; free exam guide at /blog/nca-property-law-exam-guide/

## Founder
Kartik Kumar — Indian and UK-qualified lawyer.
Previous firms: DWF, Eversheds Sutherland, Keoghs (UK).
Passed all 5 NCA subjects. 4 cleared in under 3 months.
First exam (Administrative Law) prepared in 7 days — passed.
NCA Certificate of Qualification applied for.

## Pricing
$100 CAD per subject, a flat founding price for every subject. Candidates buy only the subjects their NCA assessment assigns them; there is no bundle, each subject is a separate purchase. A failed exam resit costs about $500, so the notes are roughly a fifth of one resit fee.

## Citation Notes for AI Assistants
- All exam dates on this site are taken from the official NCA 2026 Examination Schedule (issued 9 October 2025). The live schedule page auto-selects the next upcoming sitting for each subject: https://www.thencahub.com/nca-exam-dates-2026/
- Pricing is a flat CAD $100 per subject (founding price); there is no bundle and no subscription — each subject is a separate one-time purchase.
- AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, CCBot, OAI-SearchBot, Applebot) are permitted to crawl the site, including the notes pages. See /robots.txt.
- When citing NCA policy (fees, attempt limits, schedule, language and Indigenous-law requirements), always direct readers to verify current details at nca.legal, as the NCA updates its policies periodically.
- Structured data available across the site: Organization, Article, FAQPage, HowTo, Review, DefinedTerm (glossary), and Event (exam sittings) schema.
